text: ADR compilation into obligations must be performed by an `ObligationCompiler`.
quote: An ADR is compiled into obligations by an `ObligationCompiler` once.

text: `CachedCompiler` must store compiled obligations under a key derived from both the ADR's content hash and `PROMPT_VERSION`.
quote: `CachedCompiler` stores the result under a key derived from the ADR's content hash and `PROMPT_VERSION`

text: On later runs, `CachedCompiler` must return the cached obligations without recompiling until the ADR content or `PROMPT_VERSION` changes.
quote: returns the cached obligations on every later run until either changes

text: The judge must receive compiled obligations as its input rather than the raw ADR prose.
quote: The judge sees compiled obligations, not the ADR prose.

text: Any change to the compile prompt must be accompanied by a bump of `PROMPT_VERSION`, so that every cached compile is invalidated.
quote: Changing the compile prompt requires bumping `PROMPT_VERSION`, which invalidates every cached compile.

text: Compilation must be deterministic with respect to cache state: two runs on the same ADR text and prompt version must yield identical obligations.
quote: Two runs on the same ADR text and prompt version produce identical obligations.

text: Steady-state runs must incur only judge calls, with no compile calls when the cache is valid.
quote: Steady-state cost is the judge calls only.

text: The cache directory contents must be safe to commit or share between CI and developers, so cache entries must not contain machine-specific or secret data.
quote: The cache directory is safe to commit or share between CI and developers.
